This is a beautiful fort in the spectacular Sahyadri Mountain ranges along the Western Ghats. Magnificent views of Irshalgad Fort and the Kalyan Fort are seen from this location. This fort was built in the year 1458 and has a ton of history associated with it.

Along with that, this trail is known for its magical views and the amazing flora and fauna. Even though this trail might be challenging at times but the amazing views of the Sahyadri Mountains just make up for everything. Enjoy this beautiful trek, and don't forget to take a camera to capture all the magical sceneries.

Trailhead for this particular trail lies by the Prabalgad and Kalavantini Hiking Start Point, which can be reached by taxi, cab, or private vehicle.

10 Jan 2026·Hiking

Easy to park

Great conditions

Great views

The trail is well marked and difficulty is moderate. We started around 5:30 in the morning and reached the pinnacle around 8 even though we took may breaks. You can climb to the top of the pinnacle either using a ladder or the rope (the rope is the better option imo), both routes are assisted by kind locals. Try to start early as the pinnacle starts to gets crowded around 9-10. The verticals steps, although intimidating at first are highlight of this trek. On the stairs give priority to the ones ascending and as always do not litter.

metadata.og:description:
This is a beautiful fort in the spectacular Sahyadri Mountain ranges along the Western Ghats. Magnificent views of Irshalgad Fort and the Kalyan Fort are seen from this location. This fort was built in the year 1458  and has a ton of history associated with it. 

Along with that, this trail is known for its magical views and the amazing flora and fauna. Even though this trail might be challenging at times but the amazing views of the Sahyadri Mountains just make up for everything. Enjoy this beautiful trek, and don't forget to take a camera to capture all the magical sceneries. 

Trailhead for this particular trail lies by the Prabalgad and Kalavantini Hiking Start Point, which can be reached by taxi, cab, or private vehicle.
